sentences.text:
Smt. Arati Dhara & Another vs Unknown on 7 April, 2025
Author: Jay Sengupta

Bench: Jay Sengupta
Court No. C.R.R. 1515 of 2025 Item 62 ssi 07.04.
In the matter of:- Smt. Arati Dhara & another.
Mr. Pawan Kr. Gupta Ms. Sofia Nesar Mr. Santanu Sett ...for the petitioners Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits as follows.
The petitioners are the parents in law of the alleged victim/defacto complainant.
A charge sheet has now been submitted against all the accused under Section 498A, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Earlier this Court was pleased to grant stay of the proceeding in respect of two married sisters in law and their husbands as they were staying elsewhere.
The present petitioners too were not staying with the victim as would appear from the documents pertaining to the schooling of the victim's child.
Howrah is the place where the parents of the victim were residing.
It was, therefore, quite abundantly clear that the present petitioners were not residing with the victim.

Even in the FIR,
there is hardly any specific allegation against the petitioner.
In the charge sheet, there is no independent witness cited, although the FIR refers to few of them.
Let the petitioners serve a copy of the application upon the State through the learned Public Prosecutor and upon the private opposite party by speed post with acknowledgment due, within a week.
An affidavit of service to that effect shall be filed on the next date.
List this matter for hearing as a "Contested Application" four weeks hence.
The impugned proceeding shall remain stayed for a period of six weeks from this date so far as the present petitioners are concerned.
The parties shall be at liberty to pray for extension or modification or vacating of the interim order upon notice to the other side.
The State shall produce the case diary on the next date of hearing.

(Jay Sengupta, J.)
